entities.summary: Yuriy Yuriyovych Polyukhovych is a Ukrainian diplomat, historian and civil servant. Ukrainian Mayanist researcher, historian, public and political activist, PhD in history, acting Minister of Education and Science of Ukraine from 10 to 25 March 2020. Ambassador of Ukraine to Peru, and to Colombia and Ecuador concurrently. Honorary Academician of the Latin American Academy of Military History.
